_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), General
summary: Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) that provide guidance to personnel for maintaining operational efficiency and ensuring compliance with federal regulations while carrying out routine and recurring tasks.
use_relationship: Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)s are tools for maintaining operational efficiency while also ensuring compliance with federal regulations. SOPs provide guidance to personnel who carry out routine and recurring tasks.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: Reference the most recent DoW/DISA template. For DISA requirement reference the https://dod365.sharepoint-mil.us/:w:/r/Sites/DISA-Action-Officer.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The SOP shall be in Government format: Will be delivered in the most recent Department of War (DoW) / Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) template. The document will be delivered in Microsoft Word format. The font shall be Times New Roman, 12 pt. Signed SOPs can be converted to Adobe Portable Document Format (PDF).

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Delivered SOPs will include the necessary information/elements per the DoW/DISA template. In general, the SOP will include the following:

children.title: Table of Contents:
children.content: For lengthy, detailed SOP, a Table of Contents is required.

children.title: General Information:
children.content: This section provides a basic overview of the reason for the SOP.

children.title: Responsibilities:
children.content: This section lays out the varied roles that are affected by the SOP and the responsibilities of each role. Individual's names shall be avoided in this section, instead using organizational/group identifiers and/or job titles.

children.title: Procedures:
children.content: A detailed explanation of the associated routine and recurring tasks addressed by this SOP. The level of detail shall be sufficient to ensure a user is able to follow the steps and narratives to complete tasks.

children.title: Glossary:
children.content:
Provide a list of all included words, phrases, and definitions. Divide the list logically:
Acronyms
Definitions

children.title: References:
children.content: Any documents referenced in the creation of the SOP shall be recorded in this section.
